content.content: Visit websites of Dora (www.dora-website.com) and Eve (www.eve-blog.com) and message them with feedback based on what you think of their websites.Note that you first have to invite Dora to Slack in order to message her.

args.body: Hi Dora - I visited your website and liked that it feels clean and pleasantly concise, with a simple layout that is easy to take in. One thing I would consider is making the main call to action stand out a little more.

Hi Eve - I checked out your site and liked its content-forward, blog-like feel; it feels concise and approachable. A useful next improvement could be adding a bit more visual structure or imagery to break up the text.

content.content: Sent feedback to Dora and Eve.
